apps.localizedDescription: It's just normal Filza but for jailed iPhones running iOS 12.1.3 - 13.4.1. This is possible using the Psychic Paper exploit to gain greater file access on stock iOS. Since the exploit used here was patched in iOS 13.5, do not expect many further updates to this application and it will likely never work the same on iOS 13.5 and up.
